full_name: Human Against Machine with 10,000 training images

akiec.name: Actinic Keratoses / Intraepithelial Carcinoma
akiec.description: Common pre-cancerous or early non-invasive variants of squamous cell carcinoma on sun-damaged skin.
akiec.clinical_significance: Pre-malignant / Malignant variant requiring clinical surveillance or ablation.

bcc.name: Basal Cell Carcinoma
bcc.description: The most common form of skin cancer, arising from the basal cells in the deepest layer of the epidermis.
bcc.clinical_significance: Malignant, locally destructive, low metastatic potential.

bkl.name: Benign Keratolytic Lesions
bkl.description: Group comprising seborrheic keratoses, solar lentigines, and lichen-planus-like keratoses.

df.name: Dermatofibroma
df.description: Benign fibrous nodule commonly located on the lower extremities, showing a central white patch and delicate pigment network.

mel.name: Melanoma
mel.description: Malignant neoplasm of melanocytes. Highly aggressive if not diagnosed and excised at an early in-situ stage.
mel.clinical_significance: High-risk malignant skin cancer requiring urgent histological assessment.

nv.name: Melanocytic Nevi
nv.description: Benign proliferations of melanocytes ('moles'). Dominates the HAM10000 collection.
nv.clinical_significance: Benign common mole, monitored for dysplastic progression.

vasc.name: Vascular Lesions
vasc.description: Angiomas, pyogenic granulomas, vascular malformations, and cutaneous hemorrhages with characteristic lacunar dermoscopic patterns.

train.description: Training partition optimized with class-weighted cross-entropy loss.

validation.description: Validation partition used for checkpoint early stopping and hyperparameter tuning.

test.description: Held-out test partition used for unbiased benchmark evaluation.

split_rationale: Splits are partitioned strictly at the patient/lesion level (grouping by lesion_id) to eliminate data leakage where multiple images of the same lesion appear across training and test partitions.
imbalance_strategy: Because Melanocytic Nevi (nv) comprise ~67% of all samples while Dermatofibroma (df) represents barely 1.15%, standard empirical risk minimization leads to severe majority-class bias. We utilize inverse-frequency class-weighted CrossEntropyLoss: w_c = N / (C * N_c), alongside targeted data augmentations (flips, random crops, color jitter).
